actions: su -c 'echo GPU_MIN; cat /sys/class/kgsl/kgsl-3d0/min_pwrlevel; echo GPU_CLOCK; cat /sys/class/kgsl/kgsl-3d0/gpuclk; echo THERMAL; timeout 5 dumpsys thermalservice; echo UPTIME; cat /proc/uptime'
su -c 'echo BOOT; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id; echo FOREGROUND; timeout 4 dumpsys activity activities | grep -E "mResumedActivity|topResumedActivity" || true; echo UPTIME; cat /proc/uptime'
